WARNING: 5 RIDs of type "CanvasItem" were leaked.

It might be an issue with master. I'll check. Yeah it has to do with master. Disregard above.
It looks good now from what I can see. Thanks for your effort!

Saving and loading do not happen when the dock is added or removed, this can cause data loss since adding a dock will have default values and it will overwrite the existing values, or it can be removed before it is saved.
Is it possible to save or load only 1 dock? We may want to trigger a save before a dock is removed and a load after a dock is added, somehow.
This could be fixed later though, since that is the existing behavior.
I do still find a bit weird that `available_layouts` exists as a future-proof measure. Docs are fine, now it's a matter to see if the PR is good to go.
